summary: Frontend-only verification completed for role matrix, preview retry tolerance, and mobile responsiveness across requested routes. Local role matrix passes (pending lock, coach access, admin moderation pages), mobile layouts are responsive without horizontal overflow, but moderation status updates remain blocked by Supabase RLS on community_audit_logs and preview remains flaky due repeated 429 throttling.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking resolve returns 403 with Postgres 42501 ('new row violates row-level security policy for table community_audit_logs'); UI shows retry/audit policy guidance and status is not persisted.

integration_issues.flow: Role matrix preview endpoint run (with built-in retry)
integration_issues.issue: Preview remains unstable under repeated 429 responses; first preview attempt failed with missing admin memberships table and retry failed at login input due selector timeout after throttling.

action_items: Apply/fix live DB audit-log INSERT policy chain so admin moderation resolve/reject writes can persist without RLS 42501.
Re-run moderation flow after SQL policy change to confirm queue updates persist across reload.
Harden preview allowlist/rate-limit behavior for CI automation; current 2-attempt retry is insufficient under heavy 429 bursts.
Update CI workflow package manager usage to align with repository policy (yarn instead of npm) to reduce pipeline reliability drift.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminCommunityFeedPage correctly surfaces explicit policy guidance when resolve fails, but core moderation path is still blocked by DB policy layer rather than UI logic.
connectgbb-role-matrix-e2e workflow currently uses npm ci/npm run despite project test policy requiring yarn; this can cause CI inconsistency.
Messages page mobile layout itself is responsive, but composer visibility is conditional on active conversation, so empty-conversation accounts cannot exercise send flow in this run.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Local checks are stable: pending lock PASS on feed/messages, coach feed access PASS, admin feed + memberships pages visible, and all targeted admin/dashboard pages are mobile responsive with no horizontal overflow at 390px width. Remaining blockers are preview 429 instability and unresolved audit-log RLS failure for moderation status updates.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (moderation persistence): Repro: login as admin -> /admin/feed -> click resolve on queue row. Result: 403 with 42501 and message 'new row violates row-level security policy for table community_audit_logs'; update not persisted. Root cause is DB policy chain blocking audit-log insert side-effect. Mitigation: apply/adjust audit-log INSERT RLS policy SQL and revalidate. RCA-2 (preview reliability): Repro: run /app/tests/test_connectgbb_role_matrix_e2e.py against preview URL; bursts of 429 cause partial rendering and login-selector timeout, with retries still failing intermittently. Mitigation: stronger preview allowlist/bypass or adjusted retry/backoff strategy for CI.
